changes: Added an optional DMDeletionReceiptService extension while retaining the existing DMService DeleteMessage signature and callers. The real service returns only deleted message ID, conversation ID and the existing success text after membership/ownership checks and successful repository deletion. Existing attachment/notification cleanup and WS broadcast remain in the same path.

The HTTP handler returns that additive receipt for supporting services and retains the legacy message-only response for older implementations. OpenAPI documents the backward-compatible response. No message content, keys, member list or new database schema is included.

Client HTTP deletion captures account/generation/device context and passes its guard and 15-second timeout to the existing DELETE API. Successful source-bound receipts update the visible deletion state and perform scoped local cache cleanup without waiting for WS. Partial/mismatched receipts and abandoned contexts are rejected; failed requests do not delete local records.

Legacy message-only responses use the original loaded message's conversation when available. New server receipts allow unloaded/search targets to be cleaned up too. A missing WS echo no longer prevents cleanup for a verified new receipt.
